t: itsourcecode E-Logbook with Health Monitoring System log_keeper.php sql injection
d: A flaw has been found in itsourcecode E-Logbook with Health Monitoring System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file log_keeper.php. This manipulation of the argument pid causes sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

t: itsourcecode Document Management System showlist.php sql injection
d: A vulnerability was detected in itsourcecode Document Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /showlist.php. The manipulation of the argument condition results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

t: itsourcecode Document Management System edit.php sql injection
d: A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Document Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /edit.php. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

t: twogood unshield Cabinet Descriptor libunshield.c unshield_get_cab_descriptor out-of-bounds
d: A weakness has been identified in twogood unshield up to 1.6.2. Impacted is the function unshield_get_cab_descriptor of the file lib/libunshield.c of the component Cabinet Descriptor Parser. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds read. The attack requires local access. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

t: wiroai Wiro-MCP File Upload upload-file.ts upload_file server-side request forgery
d: A vulnerability was determined in wiroai Wiro-MCP up to 1.3.0. This affects the function upload_file of the file src/tools/upload-file.ts of the component File Upload. This manipulation of the argument url causes server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. Upgrading to version 1.3.1 is able to mitigate this issue. Patch name: ac61f79888fd36fae8e282995847e542c4ef1cbd. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

t: Xinchen Technology Huangjintong Second-level System Third-generation Management Terminal System storSelect.htm sql injection
d: A vulnerability was found in Xinchen Technology Huangjintong Second-level System Third-generation Management Terminal System up to 3.2. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /paraframework/storSelect.htm. The manipulation of the argument warehouseID results in sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
r: Huangjintong Second-level System Third-generation Management Terminal System

t: jprocms Expression Language validateParam os command injection
d: A vulnerability has been found in jprocms up to 1.7.7. Affected by this vulnerability is the function validateParam of the component Expression Language Handler. The manipulation leads to os command injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

t: jprocms Database Backup StrUtil.format os command injection
d: A flaw has been found in jprocms up to 1.7.7. Affected is the function StrUtil.format of the component Database Backup Module. Executing a manipulation of the argument host/port/username/password/dbName can lead to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

t: Surya2Developer Online Shopping System GET Parameter product.php sql injection
d: A vulnerability was detected in Surya2Developer Online Shopping System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file product.php of the component GET Parameter Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument p results in sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

t: ggml-org llama.cpp llama-server sampling.cpp common_sampler_init input validation
d: A security vulnerability has been detected in ggml-org llama.cpp 0.7.0-dev. This affects the function common_sampler_init of the file common/sampling.cpp of the component llama-server. Such manipulation of the argument grammar_triggers[].type leads to improper input validation. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version b12405 mitigates this issue. The name of the patch is 9f26fe11c73c7e74a5e99e7f1b6370ad8e1cb22d. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

t: Drakeling Labs Operation Harsh Doorstop Workshop Configuration LaunchURL unrestricted upload
d: A weakness has been identified in Drakeling Labs Operation Harsh Doorstop up to 0.14.2.1 Build 19523588. The impacted element is the function LaunchURL of the component Workshop Configuration. This manipulation causes unrestricted upload. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 0.14.2.2 Build 26092794 is sufficient to resolve this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

t: Skyvern-AI Skyvern browser_egress_policy.py classify_url server-side request forgery
d: A security flaw has been discovered in Skyvern-AI Skyvern 1.0.56. The affected element is the function classify_url of the file skyvern/forge/sdk/browser_egress_policy.py. The manipulation results in server-side request forgery. The attack may be performed from remote. Upgrading to version 1.0.57 is sufficient to fix this issue. The patch is identified as 10b8d829c2750ebf62f2b70dec0e288297e752dd. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.
